name: adversarial_review

name: browser_cookies

Imports never happen here - cookie exports are posted directly to the /computer/browser-state/import endpoint; cookie values are never shown or accepted in chat.

action.description: status | enable | disable | revoke | clear | audit | import-help
action.title: Action

domain.description: site domain for enable/disable/revoke, e.g. github.com
domain.title: Domain

name: calendar_read
description: List upcoming events on the chat's primary Google Calendar.

name: cancel_task
description: Cancel a pending background task by id.

name: code_graph
description: Answer structural questions about the Noesek codebase itself: what calls a function, what a function calls, what imports a module, a module's imports, a module outline, or repo stats. Deterministic AST analysis of the installed package.

query.description: callers | callees | importers | deps | outline | stats
query.title: Query

symbol.description: function, class, or module name (not needed for stats)
symbol.title: Symbol

name: create_file
description: Create a file the user can download (notes, reports, code, csv, markdown). Returns a download path.

name.description: File name with extension, e.g. report.md
name.title: Name

content.description: Full text content of the file
content.title: Content

name: create_task
description: Create a durable background task.

name: delegate_task
description: Delegate an instruction to a specialized background worker (researcher, coder, operator, evaluator).

notify.description: Send the worker result back to this conversation
notify.title: Notify

name: design_system
description: Design-system skills: list/get schema'd themes (color, type, spacing, radius tokens) and render a self-contained styled HTML deliverable (title, subtitle, sections) into the file store.

file_name.description: render: output name in the file store
file_name.title: File Name

name: exact_solve
description: Solve exact-procedure tasks with code instead of in-head simulation (reasoning models collapse on long exact traces - Apple's Illusion of Thinking, arXiv:2506.06941). Use for puzzles, long arithmetic, state tracking, multi-step derivations: pass a small Python solver that computes and self-verifies, prints STATUS + ANSWER; a solver proving infeasibility reports UNSOLVABLE. Returns only the verified result plus a short digest.

goal.description: The exact question to answer, e.g. 'minimum moves to solve this Tower of Hanoi state with 8 disks'
goal.title: Goal

code.description: Python program that COMPUTES the answer and self-verifies it. Must print exactly one 'STATUS: VERIFIED|UNVERIFIED|UNSOLVABLE' line and one 'ANSWER: <answer>' line. When UNSOLVABLE, print a proof or the exhausted-search bound as evidence.
code.title: Code

name: forget
description: Deactivate one durable memory by id.

name: generate_variants
description: Generate N distinct candidate versions of a creative output in parallel (names, taglines, subject lines, drafts), then pick the best with a judge pass and show the rest. Use for creative asks where one shot is a lottery.

task.description: What to create, e.g. 'three tagline options for a dog-sitting app called Biscuit'
task.title: Task

n.description: How many distinct candidates to generate (2-5)
n.title: N

context.description: Optional audience/tone/constraints the candidates must fit
context.title: Context

name: geo_audit
description: Audit one HTML page for citability inside AI answers (geo-optimizer-skill method families, MIT, own-words; GEO research line arXiv 2311.09735): outbound source citations, statistics, quotations, answer-ready lead, question-form headings, extractable lists/tables, JSON-LD entity clarity with sameAs, freshness dates, AI-crawler access in robots.txt, llms.txt. Pass the page HTML plus robots_txt/llms_txt when available. Returns 0-100 score with per-check pass/warn/fail, evidence, and fixes. Companion to seo_audit - run both on website/landing deliverables.

robots_txt.description: Optional: the site's robots.txt content, for AI-crawler access checks
robots_txt.title: Robots Txt

llms_txt.description: Optional: the site's llms.txt content, if it exists
llms_txt.title: Llms Txt

name: github_notifications
description: List unread GitHub notifications for the chat's connected GitHub account.

name: gmail_read
description: Read recent Gmail inbox messages (from, subject, date, snippet) via the chat's connected Google account.

name: gmail_send
description: Send one plain-text email from the chat's connected Google account. Always requires user approval before sending.

name: humanize

name: library_docs

library.title: Library

question.description: what you need from its docs
question.title: Question

name: linkedin

name: list_tasks

status.description: pending, running, completed, failed, dead, or cancelled

name: memory_get

file.description: file name in the agent file store, ending .docx/.xlsx/.pptx

name: playbook

name.description: playbook to load; one of: interview_coach, debate, writing_tutor, teacher, terse, spec_first, tdd_flow, verify_done, storyscope, reason_route, seo_web, critic

description: Rewrite the user's own AI-sounding text so it reads naturally: cuts throat-clearing and hedge stacks, removes formulaic transitions, then applies the humanizer passes; reports rhythm issues. No claim about detectors.

name: scrub
description: Clean the user's own text or files of hidden metadata: strips invisible watermark characters from text, and removes EXIF/document-properties metadata from their own images, Office docs, and PDFs (PDF needs optional pypdf). Creates a -clean copy; originals untouched.

text.description: Text to clean of invisible watermark characters
text.title: Text

file.description: Name of a file in the download store to clean (image, Office doc, PDF, or text file)
file.title: File

name: security_audit
description: Run a bounded security audit over our own source layer: static probes (exec, shell=True, hardcoded secrets, SQL f-strings, TLS/CORS) plus route inventory; findings carry file:line evidence.

name: seo_audit

Returns 0-100 score with per-check pass/warn/fail, evidence, and fixes. Run on any website/landing deliverable before shipping.

page_type.description: homepage | service | blog | product | location | other - used for content-depth floors

Returns per-check ai/human/mixed verdicts with evidence and fixes.

story.description: The fiction draft (or excerpt) to critique
story.title: Story

focus.description: Optional: what to weight most, e.g. 'the ending' or 'dialogue'
focus.title: Focus
